notes: PR #16 release: orb surface handoff, fan clearance, and Reach legibility. One surface owns the home screen at a time — previews and navigation dismiss competing surfaces, and a stray gesture is cancelled when you navigate away. The control fan now measures its expanded blades and the dock before laying out, so controls sit clear above the dock and the drag targets what you actually see. The Reach hint is anchored above the Reach zone with a solid backing, and Reach and Horizon text contrast is improved throughout.
